description: The instructor card must never be buried under the dialog the step is asking the player to read. Boots T7 (Runnin' da Show) and probes the three steps that put a modal on screen -- the secondary-mission review (step 1), the Burden of Trust guard prompt (step 2) and the stratagem panel (step 5) -- at the base canvas AND at content_scale_factor 1.2, which is what UI Scale 1.2 (and the pad text boost) actually does to the canvas: it shrinks it to 1599x899, so a centred 700px dialog reaches into the left flank the card used to sit in at a fixed 560px width. Each probe asserts zero overlap; the 1.2 probes additionally assert the card really did narrow rather than getting lucky.

steps.comment: on a genuinely fresh profile the first-launch 'First time 'ere?' nudge is up, and its mouse_filter=STOP panel swallows clicks aimed at the menu behind it
ButtonSection sits below the menu's scroll fold at 1080p, and a click at an unscrolled control's coordinates lands on whatever is actually drawn there

steps.script: TutorialManager.current_step_id()

steps.comment: base canvas: the card dodges to a flank and must be clear of the review dialog

steps.script:
tree.root.content_scale_factor = 1.2
var d = tree.root.get_node_or_null("/root/SecondaryMissionReviewDialog")
if d == null:
	return "no review dialog"
var vp = tree.root.get_visible_rect().size
d.position = DialogUtils._bottom_position(vp, int(d.size.x), int(d.size.y), DialogConstants.BOTTOM_CLEARANCE)
return vp.x < 1920.0
steps.comment: reproduce UI Scale 1.2 / the pad text boost: shrink the canvas (1920 -> ~1599 wide) and re-anchor the dialog where popup_at_bottom would have put it on that canvas
the reported bug: at this canvas the old fixed-width left dodge left ~149px of the card under the dialog

steps.script:
tree.root.content_scale_factor = 1.0
var d = tree.root.get_node_or_null("/root/SecondaryMissionReviewDialog")

var vp = tree.root.get_visible_rect().size
d.position = DialogUtils._bottom_position(vp, int(d.size.x), int(d.size.y), DialogConstants.BOTTOM_CLEARANCE)
return true
steps.comment: back to the base canvas - the remaining real clicks inject window-pixel coordinates, which only line up at scale 1.0
it widens back out as the room comes back - not all the way to 560 while the 700px review dialog is still up (the flank only holds 548 at 1920), but nowhere near the 387 it needed at 1.2
the mission review is an embedded modal AcceptDialog on /root - emit its Continue

steps.comment: stand-in for the dialogs parented to the controller that raises them rather than to /root or /root/Main - the shooting phase's grenade and split-fire target pickers (ShootingController.gd) and the movement phase's PopupMenu. Those need a board state this lesson has no way to reach, but they sit at exactly this tree depth, which is what the overlay used to be blind to
the deep scan is throttled to 0.15s, so give discovery a moment
both halves: the card dodges it, AND the escape hatch fires so the dead footer button is greyed rather than silently swallowing clicks
and the modal gets its own Exit Tutorial in its button bar, which is the only reachable way out while it is up
PopupMenu is a Window too, so the deep scan reaches dropdowns and context menus - they must NOT count as blockers, and the card must be back to full width now the real dialog has gone
